changelog:
engineering-weekly-report v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides a structured template for weekly engineering status reports, including shipped work, progress, blockers, decisions, metrics, and priorities.
- Ensures concise, scannable output with bullet points, tables, and status tags for rapid stakeholder reading.
- Requires critical information inputs (e.g., shipped work, blockers, metrics); if missing, sections are marked [data needed].
- Emphasizes transparency (no fabricated data), explicit blockers/owners, and outcome-based next-week priorities.
- Includes optional sections for sprint details and team health.
summary: Write a weekly engineering status report for a team, service, or initiative. Use when asked to write a team update, weekly engineering report, sprint status...
